svg.text: Fact constellation: one fact at award-record grain + one genre-baseline fact · DDL in sql/dw_schema.sql
Arrows point from a dimension to the fact (1 → many) through the foreign key.
fact_grammy_nomination: one row per Grammy record (year × category × nominee × artist): 4,804.
Unmatched nominations use the unknown member (track_key = -1), so joins never drop rows.
dim_track holds only the Spotify tracks referenced by a nomination (222 + the unknown member).
fact_catalog_genre_baseline: reference population for AR1 (113 genres, built from all 89,740 tracks).
Spotify measures are non-additive: they are always averaged, never summed.
